paragraphs.sourceText: It’s difficult to estimate the number of youngsters involved in home schooling, where children are not sent to school and receive their formal education from one or both parents. 26 and court decisions have made it legally possible in most states for parents to educate their children at home, and each year more people take advantage of that opportunity. Some states require parents or a home tutor to meet teacher certification standards, and many require parents to complete legal forms to verify that their children are receiving 27 in state-approved curricula.
paragraphs.translationZh: 很难估计有多少青少年参与家庭教育，因为孩子们没有被送去学校，而是从父母一方或双方那里接受正规教育。在大多数州，立法和法院判决使父母可以合法地在家教育孩子，而且每年都有更多的人利用这一机会。一些州要求家长或家庭导师达到教师认证标准，许多州要求家长填写法律表格，以验证他们的孩子正在接受州批准的课程教学。

paragraphs.sourceText: Supporters of home education claim that it’s less expensive and far more 28 than mass public education. Moreover, they cite several advantages: alleviation of school overcrowding, strengthened family relationships, lower 29 rates, the fact that students are allowed to learn at their own rate, increased 30 , higher standardized test scores, and reduced 31 problems.
paragraphs.translationZh: 家庭教育的支持者声称，家庭教育比大众公共教育更便宜，而且效率更高。此外，他们还列举了几个优点：缓解学校过度拥挤、加强家庭关系、降低辍学率、允许学生按照自己的进度学习、增加动机、提高标准化考试成绩以及减少纪律问题。

paragraphs.sourceText: Critics of the home schooling movement 32 that it creates as many problems as it solves. They acknowledge that, in a few cases, home schooling offers educational opportunities superior to those found in most public schools, but few parents can provide such educational advantages. Some parents who withdraw their children from the schools 33 home schooling have an inadequate educational background and insufficient formal training to provide a satisfactory education for their children. Typically, parents have fewer technological resources 34 than do schools. However, the relatively inexpensive computer technology that is readily available today is causing some to challenge the notion that home schooling is in any way 35 more highly structured classroom education.
paragraphs.translationZh: 家庭教育运动的批评者认为，它解决的问题和带来的问题一样多。他们承认，在某些情况下，家庭教育提供的教育机会优于大多数公立学校，但很少有家长能够提供这样的教育优势。一些把孩子从学校退学而选择在家上学的家长，由于教育背景不足，正规培训不足，无法为孩子提供满意的教育。通常，家长可使用的技术资源比学校少。然而，当今相对便宜的计算机技术正在引起一些人对家庭教育无论如何不如高度结构化的课堂教育的观念提出质疑。

paragraphs.sourceText: Waste Not, Want Not
paragraphs.translationZh: 不浪费，不想要

paragraphs.sourceText: Feeding the 9 Billion: The Tragedy of Waste
paragraphs.translationZh: 养活 90 亿人：浪费的悲剧

paragraphs.sourceText: A) By 2075, the United Nations’ mid-range projection for global population is about 9.5 billion. This means that there could be an extra three billion mouths to feed by the end of the century, a period in which substantial changes are anticipated in the wealth, calorie intake and dietary preferences of people in developing countries across the world. Such a projection presents mankind with wide-ranging social, economic, environmental and political issues that need to be addressed today to ensure a sustainable future for all. One key issue is how to produce more food in a world of finite resources.
paragraphs.translationZh: A) 到 2075 年，联合国对全球人口的中期预测约为 95 亿。这意味着到本世纪末，可能会有额外的 30 亿人口需要养活，在此期间，全世界发展中国家人民的财富、卡路里摄入量和饮食偏好预计将发生重大变化。这样的预测向人类提出了广泛的社会、经济、环境和政治问题，这些问题今天需要解决，以确保所有人的可持续未来。一个关键问题是如何在资源有限的世界中生产更多的粮食。

paragraphs.sourceText: B) Today, we produce about four billion metric tones of food per year. Yet due to poor practices in harvesting, storage and transportation, as well as market and consumer wastage, it is estimated that 30-50% of all food produced never reaches a human stomach. Furthermore, this figure does not reflect the fact that large amounts of land, energy, fertilisers and water have also been lost in the production of foodstuffs which simply end up as waste. This level of wastage is a tragedy that cannot continue if we are to succeed in the challenge of sustainably meeting our future food demands. Where Food Waste Happens
paragraphs.translationZh: B) 如今，我们每年生产约 40 亿公吨食物。然而，由于收割、储存和运输方面的不当做法，以及市场和消费者的浪费，据估计，所生产的所有食物中有 30-50% 从未到达人类的胃中。此外，这个数字并没有反映出这样一个事实：大量的土地、能源、化肥和水在食品生产中也被损失掉，而这些最终只是被浪费掉了。如果我们要成功应对可持续满足未来粮食需求的挑战，这种程度的浪费是一场悲剧，这种悲剧就不能继续下去。食物浪费发生的地方

paragraphs.sourceText: C) In 2010, the Institution of Mechanical Engineers identified three principal emerging population groups across the world, based on characteristics associated with their current and projected stage of economic development. • Fully developed, mature, post-industrial societies, such as those in Europe, characterised by stable or declining populations which are increasing in age. • Late-stage developing nations that are currently industrialising rapidly, for example China, which will experience declining rates of population growth, coupled with increasing affluence (富裕）and age profile. • Newly developing countries that are beginning to industrialise, primarily in Africa, with high to very high population growth rates, and characterised by a predominantly young age profile.
paragraphs.translationZh: C) 2010 年，机械工程师学会根据当前和预计经济发展阶段的相关特征，确定了世界各地三个主要的新兴人口群体。 • 充分发展、成熟的后工业社会，例如欧洲的社会，其特点是人口稳定或下降，而人口年龄不断增加。 • 目前正在快速工业化的后期发展中国家，例如中国，其人口增长率将下降，同时富裕程度和年龄结构不断增加。 • 开始工业化的新兴发展中国家，主要是非洲，人口增长率从高到非常高，其特点是年轻化人口占主导地位。

paragraphs.sourceText: D) Each group over the coming decades will need to address different issues surrounding food production, storage and transportation, as well as consumer expectations, if we are to continue to feed all our people.
paragraphs.translationZh: D) 如果我们要继续养活所有人民，未来几十年每个群体都需要解决有关粮食生产、储存和运输以及消费者期望的不同问题。

paragraphs.sourceText: E) In less-developed countries, such as those of sub-Saharan Africa and South-East Asia, wastage tends to occur primarily at the farmer-producer end of the supply chain. Inefficient harvesting, inadequate local transportation and poor infrastructure（基础设施）mean that produce is frequently handled inappropriately and stored under unsuitable farm site conditions.
paragraphs.translationZh: E) 在欠发达国家，例如撒哈拉以南非洲和东南亚国家，浪费往往主要发生在供应链的农民生产者一端。收割效率低下、当地交通不便和基础设施薄弱意味着农产品经常被不当处理并储存在不适合的农场场地条件下。

paragraphs.sourceText: F) In mature, fully developed countries such as the UK, more-efficient fanning practices and better transport, storage and processing facilities ensure that a larger proportion of the food produced reaches markets and consumers. However, characteristics associated with modem consumer culture mean produce is often wasted through retail and customer behaviour.
paragraphs.translationZh: F) 在英国等成熟、完全发达的国家，更高效的耕作方式以及更好的运输、储存和加工设施确保了更大比例的生产食品到达市场和消费者。然而，与现代消费文化相关的特征意味着产品经常因零售和顾客行为而被浪费。

paragraphs.sourceText: G) Major supermarkets, in meeting consumer expectations, will often reject entire crops of perfectly edible fruit and vegetables at the farm because they do not meet exacting marketing standards for their physical characteristics, such as size and appearance.
paragraphs.translationZh: G) 大型超市为了满足消费者的期望，通常会拒绝农场生产的完全可食用的水果和蔬菜，因为它们不符合严格的物理特性（例如尺寸和外观）营销标准。

paragraphs.sourceText: H) Of the produce that does appear in the supermarket, commonly used sales promotions frequently encourage customers to purchase excessive quantities which, in the case of perishable foodstuffs, inevitably generate wastage in the home. Overall between 30% and 50% of what has been bought in developed countries is thrown away by the purchaser. Better Use of Our Finite Resources
paragraphs.translationZh: H) 对于超市中出现的产品，常用的促销活动经常鼓励顾客购买过量的产品，对于易腐烂的食品，不可避免地会在家里造成浪费。总的来说，在发达国家购买的商品中有 30% 到 50% 被购买者扔掉了。更好地利用我们的有限资源

paragraphs.sourceText: I) Wasting food means losing not only life-supporting nutrition but also precious resources, including land, water and energy. As a global society, therefore, tackling food waste will help contribute towards addressing a number of key resource issues.
paragraphs.translationZh: I) 浪费食物不仅意味着失去维持生命的营养，还意味着失去宝贵的资源，包括土地、水和能源。因此，作为一个全球社会，解决食物浪费问题将有助于解决一些关键的资源问题。

paragraphs.sourceText: J) Land Usage: Over the last five decades, improved farming techniques and technologies have helped to significantly increase crop yields along with a 12% expansion of. farmed land use. However, a further increase in farming area without impacting unfavourably on what remains of the worlds natural ecosystems appears unlikely. The challenge is that an increase in animal- based production will require more land, and resources, as livestock( 牲畜)farming demands extensive land use.
paragraphs.translationZh: J) 土地利用：在过去的 50 年里，改进的耕作技术和技术帮助显着提高了农作物产量，产量增长了 12%。耕地利用。然而，在不对世界自然生态系统剩余部分产生不利影响的情况下，农业面积的进一步增加似乎不太可能。挑战在于，以动物为基础的生产的增加将需要更多的土地和资源，因为牲畜养殖需要广泛的土地使用。

paragraphs.sourceText: K) Water Usage: Over the past century, human use of fresh water has increased at more than double the rate of population growth. Currently about 3.8 trillion m3 of water is used by humans per year. About 70% of this is consumed by the global agriculture sector, and the level of use will continue to rise over the coming decades.
paragraphs.translationZh: K) 用水量：在过去的一个世纪中，人类对淡水的使用量增长速度是人口增长率的两倍多。目前，人类每年用水量约为3.8万亿立方米。其中约 70% 被全球农业部门消耗，并且在未来几十年内使用水平将继续上升。

paragraphs.sourceText: L) Better irrigation can dramatically improve crop yield and about 40% of the worlds food supply is currently derived from irrigated land. However, water used in irrigation is often sourced unsustainably. In processing foods after the agricultural stage, there are large additional uses of water that need to be tackled in a world of growing demand. This is particularly crucial in the case of meat production, where beef uses about 50 times more water than vegetables. In the future, more effective washing techniques, management procedures, and recycling and purification of water will be needed to reduce wastage.
paragraphs.translationZh: L) 更好的灌溉可以显着提高作物产量，目前世界粮食供应的约 40% 来自灌溉土地。然而，灌溉用水的来源往往是不可持续的。在农业阶段后的食品加工过程中，需要在需求不断增长的世界中解决大量额外的用水问题。这对于肉类生产尤为重要，因为牛肉的用水量是蔬菜的约 50 倍。未来，将需要更有效的洗涤技术、管理程序以及水的回收和净化来减少浪费。

paragraphs.sourceText: M) Energy Usage: Energy is an essential resource across the entire food production cycle, with estimates showing an average of 7-10 calories of input being required in the production of one calorie of food. This varies dramatically depending on crop, from three calories for plant crops to 35 calories in the production of beef. Since much of this energy comes from the utilisation of fossil fuels, wastage of food potentially contributes to unnecessary global warming as well as inefficient resource utilisation.
paragraphs.translationZh: M) 能源使用：能源是整个食品生产周期的重要资源，据估计，生产一卡路里食品平均需要 7-10 卡路里的投入。根据作物的不同，这一热量差异很大，从植物作物的 3 卡路里到牛肉生产的 35 卡路里。由于大部分能源来自化石燃料的利用，因此食物浪费可能会导致不必要的全球变暖以及资源利用效率低下。

paragraphs.sourceText: N) In the modern industrialised agricultural process — which developing nations are moving towards in order to increase future yields — energy usage in the making and application of fertilisers and pesticides represents the single biggest component. Wheat production takes 50% of its energy input for these two items alone. Indeed, on a global scale, fertiliser manufacturing consumes about 3-5% of the world’s annual natural gas supply. With production anticipated to increase by 25% between now and 2030, sustainable energy sourcing will become an increasingly major issue. Energy to power machinery, both on the farm and in the storage and processing facilities, adds to the energy total, which currently represents about 3.1% of annual global energy consumption. Recommendations
paragraphs.translationZh: N) 在现代工业化农业进程中——发展中国家为了提高未来产量而正在迈向这一进程——化肥和农药的制造和应用中的能源使用是最大的组成部分。仅这两项，小麦生产就消耗了其能源输入的 50%。事实上，在全球范围内，化肥制造消耗了世界天然气年供应量的约 3-5%。从现在到 2030 年，产量预计将增加 25%，可持续能源采购将成为一个日益重要的问题。为农场以及储存和加工设施中的机械提供动力的能源增加了能源总量，目前约占全球年度能源消耗的 3.1%。建议

paragraphs.sourceText: O) Rising population combined with improved nutrition standards and shifting dietary preferences will exert pressure for increases in global food supply. Engineers, scientists and agriculturalists have the knowledge, tools and systems that will assist in achieving productivity increases. However, pressure will grow on finite resources of land, energy and water. The potential to provide 60-100% more food by simply eliminating losses, while simultaneously freeing up land, energy and water resources for other uses, is an opportunity that should not be ignored. In order to begin tackling the challenge, the Institution recommends that: • The UN Food and Agriculture Organisation work with the international engineering community to ensure governments of developed nations put in place programmes that transfer engineering knowledge, design know-how, and suitable technology to newly developing countries. This will help improve produce handling in the harvest, and immediate post-harvest stages of food production. • Governments of rapidly developing countries incorporate waste minimisation thinking into the transport infrastructure and storage facilities currently being planned, engineered and built. • Governments in developed nations devise and implement policy that changes consumer expectations. These should discourage retailers from wasteful practices that lead to the rejection of food on the basis of cosmetic characteristics, and losses in the home due to excessive purchasing by consumers.
paragraphs.translationZh: O) 人口增长加上营养标准的提高和饮食偏好的变化将为全球粮食供应的增加带来压力。工程师、科学家和农业学家拥有有助于提高生产力的知识、工具和系统。然而，土地、能源和水等有限资源的压力将会增大。通过简单地消除损失就可以增加 60-100% 的粮食供应，同时释放土地、能源和水资源用于其他用途，这是一个不容忽视的机会。为了开始应对这一挑战，该机构建议： • 联合国粮食及农业组织与国际工程界合作，确保发达国家政府制定计划，向新兴发展中国家转让工程知识、设计诀窍和适用技术。这将有助于改善收获期间的产品处理以及粮食生产的收获后阶段。 • 快速发展中国家的政府将废物最小化思想纳入目前正在规划、设计和建设的运输基础设施和储存设施中。 • 发达国家政府制定并实施改变消费者期望的政策。这些措施应该可以阻止零售商的浪费行为，这些行为会导致基于化妆品特性而拒绝食品，以及由于消费者过度购买而导致家庭损失。

paragraphs.sourceText: 46. Elimination of waste alone can potentially provide over sixty percent more food for the growing world population.
paragraphs.translationZh: 46. 仅消除浪费就有可能为不断增长的世界人口提供百分之六十以上的粮食。

paragraphs.sourceText: 47. The production and application of fertilisers and pesticides account for the largest part of energy use in the modem industrialised agricultural process.
paragraphs.translationZh: 47. 化肥和农药的生产和使用占现代工业化农业过程中能源使用的最大部分。

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 56 to 60 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 第 56 至 60 题基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: Call it the “learning paradox”：the more you struggle and even fail while you’re trying to learn new information, the better you’re likely to recall and apply that information later.
paragraphs.translationZh: 称之为“学习悖论”：当你尝试学习新信息时，你越努力甚至失败，你以后就越有可能回忆和应用这些信息。

paragraphs.sourceText: The learning paradox is at the heart of “productive failure,” a phenomenon identified by researcher Manu Kapur. Kapur points out that while the model adopted by many teachers when introducing students to new knowledge — providing lots of structure and guidance early on, until the students show that they can do it on their own — makes intuitive sense, it may not be the best way to promote learning. Rather, it5s better to let the learners wrestle（较劲）with the material on their own for a while, refraining from giving them any assistance at the start. In a paper published recently, Kapur applied the principle of productive failure to mathematical problem solving in three schools.
paragraphs.translationZh: 学习悖论是“生产性失败”的核心，研究人员马努·卡普尔发现了这一现象。卡普尔指出，虽然许多教师在向学生介绍新知识时采用的模式——尽早提供大量的结构和指导，直到学生表明他们可以自己做到——具有直观意义，但这可能不是促进学习的最佳方式。相反，最好让学习者自己与材料较劲一段时间，一开始就不要给他们任何帮助。在最近发表的一篇论文中，卡普尔将生产性失败原理应用于三个学校的数学问题解决中。

paragraphs.sourceText: With one group of students, the teacher provided strong “scaffolding” — instructional support 一 and feedback. With the teacher’s help, these pupils were able to find the answers to their set of problems. Meanwhile, a second group was directed to solve the same problems by collaborating with one another, without any prompts from their instructor. These students weren’t able to complete the problems correctly. But in the course of trying to do so, they generated a lot of ideas about the nature of the problems and about what potential solutions would look like. And when the two groups were tested on what they’d learned, the second group “significantly outperformed” the first.
paragraphs.translationZh: 对于一组学生，老师提供了强有力的“脚手架”——教学支持和反馈。在老师的帮助下，这些学生能够找到一系列问题的答案。与此同时，第二组被指示在没有老师任何提示的情况下通过相互合作来解决同样的问题。这些学生无法正确完成问题。但在尝试这样做的过程中，他们产生了很多关于问题的本质以及潜在解决方案的想法。当对两组所学知识进行测试时，第二组“明显优于”第一组。

paragraphs.sourceText: The apparent struggles of the floundering（挣扎的）group have what Kapur calls a “hidden efficacy”：they lead people to understand the deep structure of problems, not simply their correct solutions. When these students encounter a new problem of the same type on a test, they’re able to transfer the knowledge they’re gathered more effectively than those who were the passive recipients of someone else’s expertise.
paragraphs.translationZh: 陷入困境的群体表面上的挣扎具有卡普尔所说的“隐藏功效”：它们引导人们理解问题的深层结构，而不仅仅是他们的正确解决方案。当这些学生在测试中遇到相同类型的新问题时，他们能够比那些被动接受别人专业知识的学生更有效地转移他们收集的知识。

paragraphs.sourceText: In the real world, problems rarely come neatly packaged, so being able to discern their deep structure is key. But, Kapur notes, none of us like to fail, no matter how often Silicon Valley entrepreneurs praise the beneficial effects of an idea that fails or a start-up company that crashes and bums. So we need to “design for productive failure” by building it into the learning process. Kapur has identified three conditions that promote this kind of beneficial struggle. First, choose problems to work on that “challenge but do not frustrate.” Second, provide learners with opportunities to explain and elaborate on what they’re doing. Third, give learners the chance to compare and contrast good and bad solutions to the problems. And to those students who protest this tough-love teaching style: you’ll thank me later.
paragraphs.translationZh: 在现实世界中，问题很少会被整齐地包装起来，因此能够辨别其深层结构是关键。但是，卡普尔指出，我们没有人喜欢失败，无论硅谷企业家多么频繁地赞扬失败的想法或崩溃和失败的初创公司所带来的有益影响。因此，我们需要通过将其纳入学习过程来“针对生产性失败进行设计”。卡普尔确定了促进这种有益斗争的三个条件。首先，选择要解决的问题“有挑战但不要沮丧”。其次，为学习者提供解释和阐述他们正在做的事情的机会。第三，让学习者有机会比较和对比问题的好的和坏的解决方案。对于那些抗议这种强爱教学风格的学生：你们稍后会感谢我的。

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 61 to 65 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 第 61 至 65 题基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: Vernon Bowman, a 75-year-old farmer from rural Indiana, did something that got him sued. He planted soybeans（大豆）sold as cattle feed. But Monsanto, the agricultural giant, insists it has a patent on the kind of genetically modified seeds Bowman used — and that the patent continues to all of the progeny（后代）of those seeds.
paragraphs.translationZh: 来自印第安纳州乡村的 75 岁农民弗农·鲍曼 (Vernon Bowman) 做了一件被起诉的事。他种植大豆作为牛饲料出售。但农业巨头孟山都坚称，它拥有鲍曼使用的转基因种子的专利，并且该专利继续适用于这些种子的所有后代。

paragraphs.sourceText: Have we really gotten to the point that planting a seed can lead to a high-stakes Supreme Court patent lawsuit? We have, and that case is Bowman vs. Monsanto, which is being argued on Tuesday. Monsanto’s critics have attacked the company for its “merciless legal battles against small farmers,” and they are hoping this will be the case that puts it in its place. They are also hoping the court’s ruling will rein in patent law, which is increasingly being used to claim new life forms as private property.
paragraphs.translationZh: 我们真的已经到了播下种子可能会导致最高法院高风险专利诉讼的地步了吗？我们有，这个案件是鲍曼诉孟山都案，周二正在辩论。孟山都公司的批评者攻击该公司“对小农进行无情的法律斗争”，他们希望这件事能够让孟山都公司取而代之。他们还希望法院的裁决能够约束专利法，该法越来越多地被用来将新的生命形式视为私有财产。

paragraphs.sourceText: Monsanto and its supporters, not surprisingly, see the case very differently. They argue that when a company like Monsanto goes to great expense to create a valuable new genetically modified seed, it must be able to protect its property interests. If farmers like Bowman are able to use these seeds without paying the designated fee, it will remove the incentives for companies like Monsanto to innovate.
paragraphs.translationZh: 毫不奇怪，孟山都及其支持者对此案的看法截然不同。他们认为，当孟山都这样的公司花费巨资创造有价值的新型转基因种子时，它必须能够保护其财产利益。如果像鲍曼这样的农民能够在不支付指定费用的情况下使用这些种子，这将消除孟山都等公司创新的动力。

paragraphs.sourceText: Monsanto accused Bowman of patent infringement and won an $84,456 damage award. Rather than pay up or work out a settlement, Bowman decided to appeal — all the way to the Supreme Court. He said “Monsanto should not be able, just because they’ve got billions of dollars to spend on legal fees, to try to terrify farmers into obeying their agreements by massive force and threats.”
paragraphs.translationZh: 孟山都指控鲍曼侵犯专利并获得 84,456 美元的赔偿金。鲍曼没有付款或达成和解，而是决定上诉——一直上诉到最高法院。他说：“孟山都不应该仅仅因为他们有数十亿美元的法律费用，就试图通过大规模武力和威胁来恐吓农民遵守他们的协议。”

paragraphs.sourceText: The central issue in the case is whether patent rights to living things extend to the progeny of those things. Monsanto argues that its patents extend to later generations. But Bowman’s supporters argue that Monsanto is trying to expand the scope of patents in ways that would enrich big corporations and hurt small farmers. They say that if Monsanto wins, the impact will extend far beyond agriculture — locking up property rights in an array of important areas. Knowledge Ecology International contends that the Supreme Court’s ruling could have “profound effects” on other biotech industries.
paragraphs.translationZh: 本案的核心问题是生物的专利权是否延伸到这些生物的后代。孟山都公司辩称，其专利可以延续到后代。但鲍曼的支持者认为，孟山都正试图扩大专利范围，从而让大公司致富，同时伤害小农。他们表示，如果孟山都获胜，其影响将远远超出农业范围——锁定一系列重要领域的产权。知识生态国际认为，最高法院的裁决可能对其他生物技术行业产生“深远影响”。

paragraphs.sourceText: If this were a Hollywood movie, the courageous old Indiana farmer would beat the profit-minded corporation before the credits rolled. But this is a real-life argument before a Supreme Court that has a well-earned reputation for looking out for the interests of large corporations. This case gives the court an opportunity to rein in the growing use of patents to protect genetically engineered crops and other life forms — but the court may well use it to give this trend a powerful new endorsement.
paragraphs.translationZh: 如果这是一部好莱坞电影，那么勇敢的印第安纳老农民将在片尾字幕播放之前击败这家唯利是图的公司。但这是最高法院在现实生活中的争论，最高法院因关注大公司的利益而享有盛誉。此案使法院有机会遏制越来越多地使用专利来保护转基因作物和其他生命形式，但法院很可能利用它来为这一趋势提供强有力的新认可。
